title: Inngest Signing key (signkey-): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: _x glued after the body, boundary: signkey_prod_ in place of the hyphen delimiters, and boundary: x glued before signkey-. Twin of "Inngest Signing key (signkey-): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of inngest-signing-key-bare-prose: boundary: x glued before signkey-. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
